nodes.name: Lemma 2.2: Bound on number of large stepsizes
nodes.statement:
For any $\bm{\eta}\in(0,\infty)^{\mathbb{N}}$ and any $n\in\mathbb{N}$, we have
\[
    N_n(t) \leq \log Q_n(\bm{\eta}) + 2\log(6n) + \frac{8n}{\sqrt{t}-2}, \quad\forall t>8.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 2.3: Bound on sum of stepsizes in terms of maximum stepsizes
nodes.statement:
For any $\bm{\eta}\in(0,\infty)^{\mathbb{N}}$, let $M_n:=\max_{k\in[n]}\eta_k$ be the maximum stepsize in the first $n$ iterations.
If $Q_n(\bm{\eta})=O(1)$, then
\[
	\eta_{1:n} \leq c\cdot \left( n\sqrt{M_n} + M_n \log n + n \right), \quad\forall n\in\mathbb{N},
\]
for some universal constant $c>0$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.1: Connect convergence rates with sum of stepsizes
nodes.statement:
For any $\bm{\eta}\in(0,\infty)^{\mathbb{N}}$,
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\roman*)]
    \item we have $Q_n(\bm{\eta}) \geq \frac{1}{4(1+2\eta_{1:n})}$ for all $n\in\mathbb{N}$.
    \item If $Q_n(\bm{\eta}) = o(n^{-1})$, then $\limsup_{n\to\infty}\eta_n = \infty$.
\end{enumerate}
